notes: v1.0.22 — manual GCash payment fraud hardening (T5)
- Closed the remote route into the manual GCash confirmation flow by
revoking EXECUTE on the dormant create_gcash_checkout RPC (no new
manual awaiting_payment_confirmation orders can be created from
anywhere; legacy Aug 8–9 orders still resolve).
- POS GCash reference-number dedupe: partial unique index on
orders.gcash_reference_number scoped to paid, non-empty references —
a reference can never confirm a second paid order. The seller's
GCash confirm now surfaces a clear "reference already used" error.
- New admin-only gcash_payment_decision_audit table: RLS via
is_admin() SELECT-only, all write grants revoked including
service_role; written server-side by a POS confirm trigger and the
confirm/reject RPCs, capturing the reference number and the order
total at decision time. Retrospective pattern detection only — not
alerting.
- Seller queue screen: prominent expected-amount banner directly
above the Confirm/Reject buttons (mitigation to reduce seller error,
not a technical control — no gateway in this flow).

v1.0.21 — Security hardening & seller application integrity
- Seller applications now lock once submitted — no editing store details or swapping verification documents while pending review
- Every seller approval/rejection is logged with who, when, and notes
- Admin portal: view seller verification documents (ID, selfie, product photos)
- Map API key removed from the app — maps and geocoding now run through a secure server proxy
- Rate limiting added to public services to block abuse and overload
- Tighter upload rules for storage (file type + size checks)
Security lockout overlay with device details & admin reports
- Non-dismissable security alert with live mm:ss countdown
- Shows attacker device model, OS, and IP address
- Reset password / This wasn't me / Wait actions with loading states
- This wasn't me creates high-priority report in admin Reports tab
- Dev mode bypasses lockout and clears lockout data
- Admin portal shows lockout badges on user rows
- Push notifications to user and all admins on lockout
Fix: lockout now works locally without database dependency
- Tracks failed attempts per email in SharedPreferences
- Locks account after 5 failures for 30 minutes
- Shows attempts remaining on each failure
- Auto-clears expired lockouts
